description: Repairs r-fmt-2-pres-1/var-null-empty-ladder: only the end state was read back (the intermediate states of V were known from file hashes only), and its description said one attempt is refused although none was. Null versus empty Text on one variable field. Row 7 has T.N Null and T.V = 'v7' (V allows zero length, N is a DDL default). Steps, each with dbFailOnError: V to the empty string; V to Null; V to a value; an attempt to store the empty string in N. After every step the closed file is kept and row 7 (N, V) is read back through a read-only open, so the Null/empty state is typed after each step. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes its mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
